mode: Simulated upstream/RPC/payment; actual production UI, Node API, SQLite and signatures
checks: 390px production audit form: safe import, pinned commit, missing scope rejection, verified scope, signed domain login and mandatory disclosure before quoting.
Actual EIP-712 Permit2 and quote signatures verified by the mocked upstream; retry reads existing pending settlement with no new signature/payment.
Reload restores wallet session and durable owned order mapping; a saved signature with upstream status still quoted offers recovery without another signing action, quote or payment.
Admitted job retrieves only accepted judge findings, sanitizes report content as text, displays matching immutable metadata, and downloads a PDF with the exact accepted Markdown attached.
Network/account changes clear payable order state; a newly signed zero-UNLK wallet remains able to access audit ordering; an expired persisted session is rejected on reload.

Blocked job stays incomplete, admission refusal exposes limitations, expired quote cannot be signed, and input-check blockers hide quote controls. These are isolated fixture states with no additional payment.
limitations: No mainnet transactions, token approvals, conversion executions, live paid audits or public backend hosting were tested.
ETH/USDC conversion routes and real wallet extension UI are outside this fixture test.
PDF attachment/source fidelity was checked programmatically; printed page appearance was not visually inspected.
